articles.title: Surprise Guests Steal the Show at Don Toliver’s Star-Studded MSG Concert
articles.summary: Don Toliver’s Octane Tour hit Madison Square Garden with a string of surprise guests, including SZA, who called herself his biggest fan. The night also featured Sheck Wes, Peso Pluma, and an unreleased collaboration, turning the concert into an unforgettable event.

articles.title: Gen Z Is Bringing Back Digital Cameras — and You Can Get One for Under $100
articles.summary: Digital camera sales are surging, driven by Gen Z’s love for the vintage 2000s aesthetic. You don’t need to spend hundreds: models like the screenless Camp Snap or the 75-megapixel Demofit deliver retro vibes and modern quality for less than $100.

articles.title: Modern Hitmakers Top First-Ever Ranking of Country Music’s Greatest Songwriters
articles.summary: Ashley Gorley and Shane McAnally rank No. 1 and No. 2 on Record Research’s inaugural list of the top country songwriters from 1944–2025, surpassing legends like Willie Nelson. The study weights chart performance, giving an edge to writers in the streaming era.
